response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.order_count) AS average_count, AVG(tc.order_count - overall.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tc.order_count > overall.avg_count;
